name: Nanase Mirai
source:
A bright and cheerful childhood friend of Ao. 
Everyday, she wakes up Ao—whose parents are seldom at home—in the morning and doing the cooks. A girl who likes to taking care of others.
For some reason, she rejects Ao.

"Sorry. I'm sorry, Ao. But... I'm sorry."
